INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 2.3.1 Synonyms and Antonyms.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar 2.3.1 Synonyms and Antonyms.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 2.3.1 Synonyms and Antonyms.

====

1. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 2.3.1 Synonyms and Antonyms.

2. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.3.1 Sentence Structure - Structure - Position of nouns in a sentence.

3. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading for Information - Scanning - Main idea - Understanding the.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Intensive Listening - Listening for specific detail.

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentation Skills - Role play and dramatisat.

10. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing - Colon - Semi-colon - Bracket - Ellipsis.

11. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Functional Writing - Curriculum vitae - Speech.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading - Reading for Pleasure and general knowledge - V; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Grammar 1.3.1 Sentence Structure - Structure - Position of nouns in a sentence; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Writing 1.4.1 Functional Writing - Curriculum vitae - Speech; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
